distribution.evidence: Publicly accessible Elastic Security Labs publication at the source URL; no TLP or distribution restriction in the retained copy.

provenance.method: Independent publisher ground truth (30-report audit 2026-10-24): live publisher page re-fetched and parsed with an own heading-path walker, refang and regexes (no TalonHound zone/scope/typing/classification code); authority zones chosen by a human per report; every in-zone and out-of-zone observable reviewed one by one; linked STIX/GitHub packages diffed separately.
provenance.verified_by: manual review of the publisher text (2026-10-24)
provenance.notes: 36 IPs: Infrastructure analysis 'ARECHCLIENT2 IOC: ... the following C2 nodes are still active' = publisher-declared indicators (v36 declared lead-in). HOST-BANNER_0_HASH md5 is a web banner digest (non-file digest policy)
provenance.coverage_note: One of the 30 reports in review_required on 2026-10-24 (30-report audit); primary document only, linked packages are not part of these labels.
